title: Seat protocol v1: x-openrig seat extension
description: Value of the `x-openrig` field on a seat: what the OpenRig daemon reports about a seat beyond the core fields. Ignorable by clients that do not know it. By default only structured fields are carried: held, heldReasonCode, errorCategory and promptKind come from allowlists, never from daemon free text. The free-text fields (heldReason, lastError, promptSummary) are present only when the gateway operator opted in (capabilities.features['x-openrig.text']); they are SENSITIVE and UNTRUSTED (the daemon may put message content or credentials in them): one line, at most 300 characters. Render as text only.

version.description: Version of this extension, major.minor; the same value capabilities.extensionVersions['x-openrig'] advertises.

sessionStatus.description: Daemon sessionStatus, for example running or detached.

arbitratedNeedsInput.description: Present only when the daemon gave an authoritative answer (not null).

held.description: True when the daemon holds this seat's messages (node.heldReason is set).

heldReasonCode.description: Allowlisted hold reason; anything else is other.

errorCategory.description: Derived from startupStatus and known daemon error prefixes, else unknown. Present when the seat has an error.

promptKind.description: Allowlisted kind of the prompt the seat waits on.

promptSummary.description: Opt-in text: activityState.needsInput summary, else reason. Sensitive, untrusted.
